payload.summary: Reconciled the stale dg-06 scaffold with merged dg-02, dg-04, and dg-05 contracts. The plan now specifies pre-dispatch routing, ledger-correlated switching, canonical isolation carriage, and restart-safe loop guards while excluding completed work.
completed_work: Replaced stale parent, dependency, and scope statements.
Specified fail-closed routing, alternate-lane ledger verification, and restart-safe no-progress scenarios.
Replaced generic checklist with ordered work packages and test matrix.

decisions.title: Use a separate routing-dispatch context
decisions.rationale: Keeps dg-02 VendorResultEnvelope stable while binding each ledger lifecycle to the dg-04 assignment.

decisions.title: Keep router access host-assisted
decisions.rationale: The roadmap state machine receives a resolver protocol and never calls a model SDK or selects a vendor locally.
